_comment: A printed tag's QR is the viewer's one-entry watchlist permalink, ?w=<number> (bc-wlpl). Go builds it (playerTagURL, internal/helper/qr.go) and the viewer reads it (parseWatchlistTokens, web-mobile/js/watchlist_link.jsx). Both suites read THIS table, so the encoder and the decoder cannot drift by one side changing with its own tests. `url` is the exact string Go must produce; the JS suite asserts its query parses back to one competitor token equal to `number`, and that the viewer's own encoder writes the same token. The odd numbers are real: helper.ValidateNumberPrefix checks length only, so a prefix may hold a space, a plus, a comma or the dojo marker.
